summary: Full backend + frontend test pass for LPK Jepang MVP. 40/40 pytest tests passed covering auth, RBAC, students CRUD + docs + status pipeline, payments + kwitansi + audit-reason, finance transactions + reconciliation + cashflow, academics (classes, attendance upsert, grades avg, guru scoping), job orders + candidate scoring, dashboard/reports/audit-logs/search/notifications. Frontend UI verified: login (demo + submit), dashboard stats, period filter, all sidebar nav testids present for owner, students list + add-dialog + navigate-to-detail + tabs + change-status-btn all rendered, payments/finance/audit page testids present, guru role correctly hides Pembayaran/Keuangan/SDM/Pengguna in sidebar. Object storage upload endpoint reachable (tests skip gracefully if storage init fails, actual test upload succeeded in one run).

minor.issue: Both use full PaymentIn/TransactionIn model requiring all fields on update; sending {nominal, alasan} alone yields 422 (Pydantic) instead of the intended 400 'Alasan wajib'. Consider a partial UpdateIn model or make fields Optional so the manual 400 error path is reachable with only alasan omitted.
Uses require_roles() with no positional args; only owner passes via the owner-bypass. Works but the intent (owner-only) would be clearer as require_roles('owner').

Backend returns flattened profile (status, status_history at top-level) not wrapped in {student: ...}. Consistent with list, but the frontend should verify it consumes the correct shape (verified via ProfileTabs).

action_items: (Optional) Introduce partial-update Pydantic models for PUT /payments and PUT /finance/transactions so the 400 'Alasan wajib' path is reachable when only {nominal, alasan} is sent.
(Optional) Replace require_roles() with require_roles('owner') on delete-payment and delete-transaction endpoints for clarity.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: login sets locked_until on every failed attempt but only blocks when count>=5 AND locked_until still in future; because locked_until is refreshed on every fail, an attacker triggering 5 fails is correctly locked for 15 min. However successful logins after lock expiry aren't re-attempted here — the attempt counter is deleted only on success, so a 6th attempt exactly at lock expiry would immediately re-lock. Consider resetting count when window expires.
core.py init_storage() uses a module global `storage_key` that is not thread-safe under asyncio (multiple concurrent uploads on cold start could race). Acceptable for MVP but worth an asyncio.Lock.

finance.py next_receipt_no() uses count_documents+1 as sequence, which is not atomic and can collide under concurrent create_payment. Prefer an atomic $inc on a counters collection or Mongo findOneAndUpdate upsert.

students.py enrich() calls compute_age & payment_summary_map inline; for large student lists (>2000) sorting/aggregation is fine but doc_progress/grade_average in get_student are sequential awaits. Ok for MVP.

server.py CORS uses allow_origins '*' with allow_credentials=True — Starlette will refuse to send cookies with wildcard; set explicit origins to actually make httpOnly cookies work cross-origin (currently the frontend relies on Bearer token, so functional, but the httpOnly cookie contract is effectively unused).

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (all data-testid present, RBAC sidebar filtering works, add-student flow reaches detail page with all tabs)

UI smoke: use data-testid selectors listed in the review request; login pattern is demo-login-<role> then click login-submit-btn (demo button only fills the form). Student profile GET returns flattened fields (status/status_history at top level, no 'student' wrapper). Attendance recap returns a dict keyed by student_id. Job candidates returns {job, candidates}. Payment/Transaction PUT models are non-partial (send full body plus alasan).
rca of the issue: N/A — all functional tests pass. Initial pytest failures were due to test payloads not matching Pydantic schemas (nama_lengkap vs nama, alamat dict vs string, komponen dict vs list, response shape mismatches); corrected in test file.
